description: This file defines FastAPI dependencies related to authentication and authorization, including functions to get the current user from JWT tokens, and factories for permission and role checks within the system.

methods.name: get_db()
methods.description: Creates and manages a database session, yielding a SQLAlchemy session or raising an HTTP 503 error if the database can't initialize.

methods.name: User get_current_user( credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Depends(reuseable_oauth2), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Extracts user information from a JWT token and retrieves the corresponding User object from the database, raising an HTTP 401 error if invalid.

methods.name: Callable require_permission(permission_name: str)
methods.description: Factory function that returns a dependency to check if the current user has a specific permission within their organization.

methods.name: Callable require_role(role_name: str)
methods.description: Factory function that returns a dependency to verify if the current user has a specific role within their organization.

methods.name: dependency( current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
